text:
marie: Kicking off sundown drain sweep on router pool eu-west. Plan: tilt weights 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~12m. Pin backend to v2.4.1 (no auto-promote). Change window ends 01:30 UTC. Abort criteria: p95 > 220ms for >3m or errors/sec > 3x baseline.

sam: Copy. Who's on rollback if we need it? @kate-oncall?

oliver: I'll handle LB changes and drain. Router CLI I'm using: `routerctl shift --pool eu-west --from v2.4.0 --to v2.4.1 --step 10 --interval 180s --preserve-sessions`

deploy-bot: Deploy started for service 'generation' tag v2.4.1 — canary 10% at 4091012355. Logs: `deploy: canary-started, route=eu-west, weight=10`

sam: Posting release notes: https://redwood.app/releases/2.4.1 — batching fix + kv-cache miss reduction. QA smoke is green.

kate-oncall: Oncall ack. Dashboards pinned. Abort/runback instructions: if errors/sec > 3x or p95 > 220ms for >3m then: `routerctl set-weight eu-west 100% v2.4.0` then `kubectl rollout undo deployment/generation -n prod` and open incident channel #inc-rolling-back.

marie: Good. I'll run a small probe after each step: `curl -H "x-test: canary" https://api.eu.redwood.internal/health?version=2.4.1` — post results here.

deploy-bot: Canary 30% at 4091012450. Observability snapshot: p95=185ms, errors=0.2/s, qdepth=12.

oliver: Saw two 500s at ~4091012458 from worker az-b. Draining az-b now and routing around.

sam: Noted. If repeats, hold tilt and prepare hotfix branch. @marie want me to pre-stage rollback image?

marie: Yes — hold tilt if >2 5xx in 5m. Sam please pre-stage `v2.4.0-hotfix` and keep warm in registry. Also pin sessions on the router until drain completes.

kate-oncall: If we roll back, notify infra + open incident channel and ping PS and ENG-LEADS. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary 60% at 4091012510 — metrics: p95=210ms, errors=0.5/s, minor tail variance. Reaction: :eyes:

marie: Holding at 60% for 6m to observe. Everyone watch p95, queue depth, and 5xx bursts.

sam: Running a targeted perf run against the degraded path now, will post results in ~3m.

oliver: Keeping drain logs here for quick lookup: ```
# drain log excerpt
NODE az-b STATUS draining
connections: 12 -> 0
evac start: 4091012462
```

marie: Thanks. If stable after hold, we finish tilt to 100% and unpin. If not, execute rollback playbook above and use `routerctl sweep --rollback --to v2.4.0` to do a fast restore.

kate-oncall: Copy. I'll stay on watch until unpin complete. Ping me if you want incident auto-alert escalations. :thumbsup:
